$comment: Canonical brand, naming and third-party registry. Provisional internal source of truth for Phase 0. NOT legal advice and NOT a trademark clearance. Every mark here is unregistered and unadjudicated unless a decision record says otherwise.
generatedNote: Hand-authored. Consumed by thesmos/brand.ts and enforced by `thesmos brand:lint`.

legal.$comment: No surface may imply Thesmos is a separate legal company. Thesmos is a product line of Holley Studio LLC.
legal.trademarkSymbolNote: Do not add ™ or ® during Phase 0. Symbol use presupposes a clearance decision that has not been made.

masterBrand.name: Thesmos
masterBrand.riskBasis: An active developer-tool ecosystem uses 'ThesmOS', thesmos.sh and go.thesmos.sh, including MCP and AI coding-agent tooling. Overlapping goods/services in the same channel.
masterBrand.meaning: Greek term associated with rule, law, ordinance or established institution.
masterBrand.narrativeNote: Thesmos is a concept (law/order), NOT a deity and NOT the fire-stealing titan (that is Prometheus). Do not portray Thesmos as a historical god.

productFamilies.description: Deterministic governance engine: rules, scanning, validation, reporting.
Conversational surface for working with Thesmos Agents.

productFamilies.uiCopyAllowance: UI copy may say 'Create with Zeus.' Zeus is the orchestration personality inside Thesmos, not a standalone product.

tiers.description: Complete core governance engine and rules, local scanning, a limited starter-agent set derived from the catalog, and Thesmos Builder Lite where implemented. Genuinely useful, not a crippled demo.

tiers.priceNote: Authoritative commercial source is external (Gumroad). Not verifiable inside this repository. Generated marketing must not publish a number while priceStatus is 'unverified'.
tiers.description: Complete Thesmos Pantheon catalog, complete eligible skill catalog, advanced Thesmos Builder, Zeus orchestration, multi-platform agent exports.
Reserved for future organizational controls, team governance, shared policy, audit administration and support.
tiers.note: Must NOT be marketed as available until the capabilities exist.

agentCollective.firstUseRule: Public references must use 'Thesmos Pantheon' on first use in a document or page. 'Pantheon' alone is permitted afterwards as a narrative short form.
agentCollective.narrativeCategoryRule: 'God Agents' may remain mythology-flavored narrative language but must not be the only category customers see. 'Thesmos Agents' is the canonical category.

publicDisplayRules.message: 'Pantheon Pro' is not a product. Use 'Thesmos Pro'.
'Pantheon Chat' must not be the primary product name. Use 'Thesmos Chat'.
'Zeus Forge' is superseded. Use 'Thesmos Builder' (UI copy may say 'Create with Zeus').
Use 'Full Thesmos Pantheon' or 'complete Thesmos agent catalog'.
'Nike' is a famous commercial trademark and must not appear as a current public product or agent name. Canonical: 'Thesmos Lead Generation Agent' (id lead-generation-agent).
Thesmos is a product line of Holley Studio LLC, not a separate legal entity.
Thesmos is a term for law/order, not the fire-stealing titan (Prometheus). Remove this narrative.
Do not use ™ or ® during Phase 0 — clearance has not been decided.

nameClassifications.name: Pantheon
nameClassifications.basis: Active WebOps, workflow and governance software company at pantheon.io operating in an overlapping software category.
allowedUses: narrative short form after 'Thesmos Pantheon' first use

nameClassifications.name: Zeus
nameClassifications.note: Orchestration personality inside Thesmos. Not a standalone product.

nameClassifications.name: Atlas
nameClassifications.note: Separate Holley Studio product. Do not rename in this repository.

nameClassifications.name: Iris
nameClassifications.note: Separate Holley Studio product. Do not rename in this repository.

nameClassifications.name: Eunomia
nameClassifications.note: Greek personification of good order — thematically aligned with the master brand's meaning.
